definitions.explanation: An exchange of questions and answers between a Zen master and a disciple, used as a means of training toward enlightenment.
A conversation that makes no sense to the listener, because the answers do not seem to fit the questions.

examples.japanese: {禅問答|ぜんもんどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}する→修行する：25391_shugyousuru⟧。
{師|し}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{禅問答|ぜんもんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わした→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
examples.english: The master and the disciple exchanged Zen questions and answers.

examples.english: At Zen temples, the master poses questions with no ready answer to the disciple. That is a Zen dialogue.
